content:
Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a New York–based chemical company headquartered at 363 East 42nd Street, New York, NY 10017. Positioned in one of the world’s most dynamic business and scientific hubs, Standardpharm focuses on the development, manufacturing, and distribution of high-quality chemical products that support research, industrial production, and advanced manufacturing.

As a specialized chemical supplier, Standardpharm serves a broad range of clients, including pharmaceutical manufacturers, biotechnology firms, academic laboratories, contract research organizations, and industrial producers. Its portfolio typically includes fine chemicals, intermediates, specialty reagents, and custom-formulated compounds designed to meet rigorous performance and purity requirements. The company places a strong emphasis on product consistency, reliability of supply, and technical support, helping customers streamline their processes from early-stage R&D through to commercial-scale operations.

Standardpharm Co., Ltd. operates with a commitment to regulatory compliance, safety, and environmental responsibility. Working within U.S. and international standards, the company aims to maintain traceability, transparent documentation, and robust quality control systems across its supply chain. From sourcing raw materials to packaging and logistics, Standardpharm seeks to deliver dependable service and responsive customer care. Located in midtown Manhattan, the company is well positioned for collaboration with global partners, leveraging New York’s connectivity, talent pool, and innovation ecosystem to support clients both domestically and worldwide.
